title: Channel classes with multiplicativity at p = 2

collection.label: Ruskai
collection.title: Open problems in quantum information theory

question.summary: Many nontrivial channel classes have multiplicative maximal output 2-norm, including PPT-inducing channels tensored with arbitrary channels. No exhaustive characterization exists.
question.importance: A structural classification would locate the boundary where tensor products preserve maximal output purity. That boundary organizes the positive cases left after general multiplicativity failed.
question.unresolved: Identify further positive classes or give an exhaustive structural characterization of channels satisfying multiplicativity at p equals two.

formulation.notation:
| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $M_d$ | Algebra of complex $d\times d$ matrices |
| $\rho$, $\gamma$ | Density matrices on a finite-dimensional Hilbert space |
| $\Phi$, $\Omega$ | CPT (completely positive trace-preserving) linear maps (quantum channels) |
| $\lVert M\rVert_p$ | Schatten $p$-norm, $\lVert M\rVert_p=(\operatorname{Tr}\lvert M\rvert^p)^{1/p}$ |
| $\nu_p(\Phi)$ | Maximal output $p$-norm, $\sup_\gamma\lVert\Phi(\gamma)\rVert_p$ |
| WH channel | Werner–Holevo channel |
| Mutually unbiased bases (MUB) | Orthonormal bases $\{\lvert e_j^{(a)}\rangle\}$ such that $\lvert\langle e_j^{(a)}\vert e_k^{(b)}\rangle\rvert^2=1/d$ for $a\ne b$ |
| Depolarized channel | $\Phi_{x,\epsilon}=x\mathcal I+(1-x)\mathcal M_\epsilon$ for some $\mathcal M_\epsilon$ near a fully depolarizing map |
formulation.statement:
**Problem 12.** For what classes of quantum channels $\Phi,\Omega$ can the multiplicativity identity
$$
u_p(\Phi\otimes\Omega)=
u_p(\Phi)\,
u_p(\Omega) 	ag{24}$$
be proved at $p=2$?

progress.title: PPT-inducing channels form a broad positive class
progress.detail: Dierckx, Fannes and Vandenplas prove 2-norm multiplicativity when one tensor factor is PPT-inducing and the other is arbitrary.
